name: Eternal Ring ~Miwaku no Yakusoku~
original_name: エターナル・リング～魅惑の約束～
source:
"I'm not going to ask you to break up with me... for now."

"We seem to agree on a lot of things."

"Won't you call me 'Teach' just one more time?"

After a night of heavy drinking, you wake up in an unfamiliar place... where are you?!
A fateful encounter with a headstrong, yet charming man...
An office romance with the son of an esteemed family...
Even a meeting with the teacher you once looked up to is making your head spin.
Which of these men will be the one to promise you love for all eternity?

[Translated from [url=http://www.andamul.com/special/ring.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
“我不会要求你和我分手……暂时不会。”

“我们好像在很多事上都很合得来。”

“能再叫我一次‘老师’吗？”

一夜豪饮后，你在陌生的地方醒来……这是哪里？！
与强势却迷人的男人命中注定般地相遇……
与名门公子展开办公室恋情……
就连重逢曾经仰慕的老师，也让你心神不宁。
究竟哪位男子，会向你许下永恒的爱情誓言？

[译自 [url=http://www.andamul.com/special/ring.html]official website[/url]]
